mapper.select: SELECT FROM stk_fund_performance WHERE fund_code = #{fundCode} AND stat_date = #{statDate}
SELECT p.*, f.fund_name, f.fund_type FROM stk_fund_performance p LEFT JOIN stk_fund f ON p.fund_code = f.fund_code WHERE p.${period} IS NOT NULL ORDER BY p.${period} DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO stk_fund_performance (fund_code, stat_date, return_1w, return_1m, return_3m, return_6m, return_1y, return_3y, return_5y, return_since_establish, max_drawdown_1y, max_drawdown_3y, sharp_ratio_1y, sharp_ratio_3y, volatility_1y, excess_return_1y, rank_1y, morningstar_rating, galaxy_rating, create_time) VALUES (#{fundCode}, #{statDate}, #{return1w}, #{return1m}, #{return3m}, #{return6m}, #{return1y}, #{return3y}, #{return5y}, #{returnSinceEstablish}, #{maxDrawdown1y}, #{maxDrawdown3y}, #{sharpRatio1y}, #{sharpRatio3y}, #{volatility1y}, #{excessReturn1y}, #{rank1y}, #{morningstarRating}, #{galaxyRating}, NOW())
